newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Dull Manila bourse ends down, PLDT may bring cheer.
newsitem.headline: Dull Manila bourse ends down, PLDT may bring cheer.

text.p: The Manila stock exchange remained dull on Thursday with prices little changed and the index ending a shade down.
"Tomorrow may also be the same but PLDT may be the saving grace," Patrick Garcia of L.M. Garcia and Associates said.
He said there was no action because everyone was watching how U.S. markets were reacting to Fed jitters. There are fears U.S. rates may be raised when the Fed meets on September 24.
Garcia said PLDT's gain in New York on Wednesday had raised hopes it would rise further. "It's looking good, like it wants to move higher and break through the $60 mark," he said.
Blue chip PLDT's ADR has a major influence in Manila and brokers said its rise could give the boost to a market poised for a rise as local factors were encouraging.

Last weekend, the Philippines reported robust growth in first half gross national product figures and on Thursday the government announced August inflation had fallen to 7.9 percent year on year from 8.9 percent in July.
